title: CHECKPOINT payload
description: Merkle tree hash over all preceding event hashes, with the tree size, the operator signature and an optional external receipt. Emitted periodically (every N events or T_cp) on an active, unquarantined session whose hash chain verifies.

root.description: Merkle tree hash (RFC 9162, Section 2.1.1) over the event hashes of the events 0..tree_size-1 of this session: a leaf is SHA-256(0x00 || event_hash), an interior node SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), a tree of more than one leaf is split at the largest power of two smaller than its size, and the hash of the empty tree is SHA-256 of the empty string.

tree_size.description: Number of events covered by this checkpoint (the tree has this many leaves); the CHECKPOINT event itself is the next one.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature under the operator key, over canonical JSON of [root, tree_size]. Hex-encoded. The reference bridge writes a placeholder.

receipt.description: Optional. Receipt from an external append-only transparency log (e.g., SCITT) that anchors this checkpoint.
